product.name: Prêt Viager Hypothécaire (Reverse Mortgage Loan)
product.description: A loan for seniors aged 60+ allowing them to borrow against their home equity without monthly repayments, repaid upon their death or sale of the property.

product.name: Rente Viagère (Lifetime Annuity)
product.description: A financial product providing seniors with guaranteed monthly income for life to supplement retirement funds.

product.name: Financing Advisory for Seniors
product.description: Consultation service to help seniors understand and choose appropriate viager financing solutions for retirement.

product.name: Online Loan Simulation Tool
product.description: A web-based tool that allows seniors to estimate their borrowing capacity and potential financing based on their property value.

identifier.value: Property Valuation and Energy Diagnosis Service

product.name: Property Valuation and Energy Diagnosis Service
product.description: An expert evaluation of the senior's property value and energy efficiency to support loan application and financing decisions.
